title: Investigation + Hotfix: intermittent Hosted API 5xxs, client timeouts and retry amplification
creator: Amira Patel
description: Multiple paying Hosted API customers reported elevated 5xx rates and client-visible timeouts beginning 2026-02-19 04:00 UTC. Symptoms: transient 502/503/504 responses, long tail latency for streaming responses, and significant client retry activity amplifying load. This ticket captures the investigation, short-term mitigations already deployed, and the longer-term fixes needed to prevent recurrence.
impact_summary: Approximately 8% of requests for affected tenants returned 5xx during the incident window; several customers opened escalations citing user-facing errors and automated retry loops. Errors impacted both streaming and non-streaming endpoints. Internal Pager triggered at 04:10 UTC; SRE and Serving Runtime teams engaged.
repro_steps: Load test harness with high concurrent short requests (2k rps) to text-generation endpoints replicates elevated 5xxs when backend model pool utilization > 85%.
Simulate client SDK aggressive retry (default 3 retries with exponential backoff) and observe retry amplification causing connection pool exhaustion in model-proxy.
Replay real traffic from customer X (scrubbed and sampled) in staging to validate the failure mode.
root_cause_findings: Primary: model-proxy connection pool exhaustion under bursty concurrent retries — proxy dropped connections returning 502 and client SDK retried causing a feedback loop.
Secondary: inaccurate health scoring for GPU backends causing the router to keep routing to partially degraded nodes instead of failing fast.
Tertiary: circuit-breaker implementation had an edge-case where streaming KeepAlive resets were treated as success, delaying tripping of circuit for overloaded nodes.
short_term_mitigations: Reduced default SDK retry attempts from 3 to 1 for hosted customers via a server-side header override (rolled 2026-02-20 08:30 UTC).
Enabled fast-fail circuit-breaker for any backend with >90% connection error rate (feature flag hotfix deployed 2026-02-20 09:10 UTC).
Increased model-proxy connection pool size by 30% for affected clusters as an immediate capacity relief (rolled 2026-02-20 10:45 UTC).
Applied temporary ingress backpressure: queue length cap and 429 responses for lower-tier traffic to preserve capacity for committed customers (rolled 2026-02-20 12:00 UTC).
proposed_long_term_fixes: Fix model-proxy keepalive handling so idle resets don't count as successes; add robust connection retry with jitter under the hood.
Improve health scoring: incorporate queue latency and per-backend recent 5xx ratio into scoring algorithm; target accuracy under noisy conditions.
Add proactive client-side guidance: SDKs should backoff more aggressively when receiving 502/503 cluster-wide signals; expose server-side retry budget headers.
Implement end-to-end chaos test that simulates partial GPU node degradation and validates router/circuit-breaker behavior in CI.
Tune autoscaler to react faster to sustained high queue lengths; create a short-interval burst scale path for Dedicated and Hosted clusters.
rollout_plan: Canary the model-proxy keepalive fix to region eu-west-1 with 5% traffic (runtime-1.23-canary). Monitor 5xx rate, queue length, and client-side retries for 24h. If metrics look good, extend to us-west-2 and us-east-1 over 48h followed by global rollout. All mitigation changes behind feature flags for rapid rollback.
testing_plan: Unit tests for keepalive behavior; integration test with staged model backends to simulate connection errors; synthetic traffic tests (1k, 2k, 5k rps) with varied retry policies; post-deploy golden metric checks and automated alerting if 5xx or queue length regress by >20% compared to baseline.
monitoring_and_alerting_changes: Create new SLO alert for 'router queue length 90p' and 'per-backend 5xx rolling 5m' with page severity. Add dashboards showing retry amplification ratio (retries/request) and per-tenant retry fallout.
rollback_strategy: Feature flags to disable fast-fail and keepalive changes instantly. If 5xx increases or tail latency regresses >15%, revert canary to previous runtime image and reopen ingress capacity by decreasing queue pressure.
notes: Customers A, B, and C had the strongest signal; legal/comms require a short customer-facing summary once the postmortem is finalized. We intentionally avoid naming customers in public docs. This ticket will be the canonical engineering action plan; the postmortem will reference it.

Retry amplification ratio reduced by >= 60% for synthetic tests with aggressive client retries.
New alerts fire correctly and pages are actionable; runbook updated with clear mitigation steps.
Postmortem published and customer comms approved.
